claim_ceiling: This benchmark proves only that REAL cached OpenCaseLaw rows carry the fields the query_result_bundle contract needs (decision_id, canonical_url on mcp.opencaselaw.ch, language, citation strings, statutes, a frozen-marker-rule text surface) and that the ACCEPTED harness rejects a regressed bundle. It does NOT prove that Product builds such a bundle, that the map is useful to a jurist, that counter labels are calibrated (counter_uncertainty is a fixed fixture constant), that the coordinates are a good layout (they are a deterministic fixture layout, not a geometry claim), or anything about the absolute LABEL_SOUND / GEOMETRY_SOUND bars. Recall figures are measured, not thresholded.
evidence_summary: Frozen spec SHA256 187b0e54b03b326c62d45d8ba48fc78dc88501086761cd91a84c304a7478ba72 verified unchanged pre/post execution. 24 raw HTTP-200 OpenCaseLaw envelopes, 100% matched to frozen queries. 4 frozen questions evaluated. All 7 harness checks PASS for all questions (bundle_nonempty, duplicate_free, source_urls_valid, answer_citations_constrained, counter_classifications_supported, geometry_preserved_after_enrichment, progressive_phases, no_fixture_in_live_claim). Both falsification legs fire for all questions: blanking counter_evidence → counter_classifications_supported=false; breaking one canonical_url → source_urls_valid=false. Counter-authority yield: 2/4 questions have zero candidates (corporate-criminal-liability, business-judgment-rule) — negative result honestly published. Known relevant recall 0.5-1.0, known counter reach 0.25-0.67 (measured, not thresholded). Bundle artifacts: 8 files (4 questions × initial/final), schema lex-query-map-bundle/1. Provenance: fixture_mode=true, network_calls=0, offline replay only. Claim ceiling explicit and accurate. No legacy 174k science demanded. Vertical slice honest and executable.
